name: Sky Dragon Slayer
description: (Tag:draconic)(Tag:healing)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a sky dragon. You generate, control, alter your winds such as blunt or sharp, devour wind, heal others with your winds, and are immune to wind-based attacks below your level. Breathing air recovers vitality and energy, though polluted air harms you, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your wind attacks.
